items.title: People Are Quickly Cloning Indie Games Using AI Tools
items.excerpt: Solo developers are using AI coding tools to spin up playable clones of indie games within days, sometimes before the original even ships, and push them to storefronts first. It is a concrete workflow shift that is reshaping how small studios share and protect in-progress work.

items.title: Steam study of over 53,000 games finds "60 – 90% of the growth" in monthly releases on Valve's store is from games using AI and "almost none of them make money"
items.excerpt: A 53,000-game analysis attributes 60-90% of the growth in monthly Steam releases to AI-disclosed titles, while finding almost none of them earn money. The hard data reframes AI's real impact on release throughput versus commercial outcomes for working developers.

items.title: Devs don't buy Steam disclosure claiming gen AI was a necessity: "I'm literally unemployed and I still make all of my assets by hand"
items.excerpt: A dark-fantasy idle ARPG's Steam disclosure argued generative AI was a budget necessity, drawing sharp pushback from developers who say they still hand-make assets. The dispute is a live case study in how gen-AI reliance is being justified and contested inside real production pipelines.

items.title: "Good games will get cloned and buried" – AI vibe coding is one of the biggest threats on storefronts like Steam, analyst warns
items.excerpt: An analyst warns that AI 'vibe coding' lets copycats clone and bury quality games in a flood of near-instant knockoffs on storefronts like Steam. It frames AI-accelerated cloning as a discovery and design threat, not just a moderation problem, for developers.

items.title: In An Era Of AI Slop, Meccha Chameleon Embraces Human-Crafted Chaos
items.excerpt: Breakout hit Meccha Chameleon is being positioned as a deliberately human-crafted counterpoint to the wave of AI-generated 'slop' and copycats flooding storefronts. It is a craft-and-design argument about handmade chaos as a competitive differentiator against generative pipelines.
